author: Unity
description:
In Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes, made with Unity, take command of a fleet escaping the annihilation of the Twelve Colonies. Manage crises on board as you prepare for the next encounter with the Cylon Fleet. Times are dire, and hard choices must be made. Your only hope: rejoin the Battlestar Galactica.

Developed by: Alt Shift
Published by: Dotemu

Check out the game: https://on.unity.com/PlayBattlestarGalactica
Learn more and submit your project: https://on.unity.com/MWU
Discover more Unity-powered games: https://on.unity.com/MWU-Steam

#MadeWithUnity #UnityGames #Unity #BattlestarGalactica
